description: This file defines the class ImapHandlerFake, which is used for testing purposes within the SuiteCRM project. It implements the ImapHandlerInterface and uses a fake data object to simulate IMAP handler functionalities such as connecting to mailboxes, fetching emails, and managing messages.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFake
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ImapHandlerInterface for testing, simulating IMAP operations using a fake data provider.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fake data object.

methods.description: Returns the current connection resource or false.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IMAP server is available.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the server to keep connection alive.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header information for a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches the body of a message.

methods.description: Gets the body content of a message.

methods.name: getNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns the total number of messages.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of messages with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
